summary: soispoke 提交 EIP-8272，让 frame 交易在验证时引用最近的根而无需读取可变存储，为隐私交易证明“对某个近期承诺树成立”提供协议支持。ethresear.ch 用 Lean 4 形式化 FOCIL 的“N 选 1 诚实”包含保证。vdWijden 强调 CROPS 里最重要的是安全。

items.title_en: New EIP: Recent Roots for Frame Transactions

items.title: ethresear.ch：用 Lean 4 形式化 FOCIL
items.note: 21:56（rahul）：FOCIL（EIP-7805）是 Hegotá 的抗审查头条功能，常说的卖点是“包含列表委员会中只要一个不作恶的成员列出某笔交易，就能强制其进入规范区块”，文章在 Lean 4 中检验这一说法。
items.note_en: 21:56 (rahul). FOCIL (EIP-7805) is the censorship resistance headliner for Hegotá, and its selling point is "1-out-of-N honesty among IL committee members": one non-equivocating member listing a transaction is enough to force its inclusion; the post examines that claim in Lean 4.

items.title: EIP-8243：源头批量证明讨论帖
items.note: 21:17（raul），让在同一时隙委员会中运行多个验证者的运营方发布一个预聚合证明，代替 N 个单独证明。

items.note_en: 21:17 (raul), letting operators running several validators in the same slot committee publish one pre-aggregated attestation instead of N.

keywords_en: EIP-8272 recent roots for frame transactions submitted
summary_en: soispoke submitted EIP-8272, letting frame transactions reference recent roots during validation without reading mutable storage, giving protocol support for private transactions that must prove against a recent commitment tree. ethresear.ch formalized FOCIL's "1-out-of-N honesty" inclusion guarantee in Lean 4. vdWijden stressed that security is the most important part of CROPS.
